name: v6-whine-clean
note: Hand-derived from acoustic.json toward an acoustic, echoey, whiny, raspy timbre; not fitted. The clank on bass notes (a damped mechanical oscillation) comes from the strike-point comb re-peaking above its first null at partial 8.4, left loud in the bass because rolloff_at(E1)=0.82 against 3.02 at A4: partials 11-14 land at 457-585 Hz on a low E. Variants named b* attack that; v* explore timbre.
